mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id, u.tenant_id, a.username, a.password_hash, u.enabled AS user_enabled, a.enabled AS account_enabled FROM iam_local_account a INNER JOIN iam_user u ON u.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND u.user_id = a.user_id WHERE a.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND a.username = #{username}

SELECT DISTINCT p.permission_code FROM iam_user_role ur INNER JOIN iam_role r ON r.tenant_id = ur.tenant_id AND r.role_id = ur.role_id AND r.enabled = 1 INNER JOIN iam_role_permission rp ON rp.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND rp.role_id = r.role_id INNER JOIN iam_permission p ON p.permission_code = rp.permission_code WHERE ur.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ur.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY p.permission_code
